comments.content: The error message in startContainersWithMixedImage has the arguments swapped: it says 'Requested nodeIndex: %d, cluster size: %d' but passes (server.clusterSize(), nodeIndex). Should be (nodeIndex, server.clusterSize()).

The exception message format string uses %d twice but the arguments are in wrong order. The message says 'Requested nodeIndex: %d, cluster size: %d' but passes server.clusterSize() first, then nodeIndex. This will produce confusing error messages.
The IllegalArgumentException message in LoadBalancer.node() has swapped arguments: format string expects (nodeIndex, clusterSize) but passes (clusterSize, nodeIndex).
